Package com.nexuslink.protocol.secrets

Class VaultPaths

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.secrets.VaultPaths
public final class VaultPaths extends Object
Pure, dependency-free helpers for building HashiCorp Vault KV v2 API paths and normalising a server address. Kept separate from VaultService so the URL logic (the fiddly part of a KV v2 client — data vs. metadata endpoints) is unit-testable without a running Vault.

KV v2 routes secret reads/writes through {mount}/data/{path} and listing/metadata through {mount}/metadata/{path} — unlike KV v1 where the mount and path are simply joined.
